title: ProgressionFirstJoin
description: First-join onboarding + safety—stop bad spawns and early frustration instantly.
body:
# ProgressionFirstJoin

The first minutes decide if a player stays. ProgressionFirstJoin makes sure they do: safe spawn behavior, controlled first-join flow, and protection from the classic “fell into void / wrong world / stuck” disasters. Install it and your server instantly feels more professional.

# Highlights:

Reliable first-join handling

Safety fallback/rescue logic (spawn protection style)

Perfect for hubs, tutorials, and multi-world setups

Perfect for: public servers, networks, polished onboarding.

# Why you’ll love it

First minutes become smooth and professional

Prevents classic “spawn failed / void death” rage quits

Great for public servers and networks

# Features

Reliable first-join handling

Safety fallback/rescue behavior

Ideal for hubs/tutorial worlds

# Setup

Install the plugin

Set spawn/onboarding settings

Test first join flow with a new account

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Works with multi-world setups
